description: List the booking requests people sent to the signed-in user: who asked, what they need, when, and whether it is still waiting for an answer. Use it when the user asks what is waiting on Foundaree, who wants to book them, or what they have not answered yet. Needs the user to have connected their Foundaree account. Lead with the ones still waiting, and offer to answer them with respond_to_booking.
name: my_bookings
title: The user's own booking requests
